metadata.title: Let's Play Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker
metadata.description:
"Ten years after MGS3, MSG: Peace Walker visits Big Boss and Master Miller as they build an ocean clubhouse for men only."

Chip and Ironicus play Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker, released in 2010 for the PlayStation Portable and 2011 for Xbox 360 and Playstation 3. 27 episodes, most of them in multiple parts, published between December 15 2012 and May 18 2013.
